messages.content:
Three independent readers read the same non-disclosure agreement (NDA) and decided whether it supports one statement (the hypothesis). They may agree or disagree, and a program has checked each of their quotes against the document. Your job is to make the final decision yourself, from the document.

<document>
<document 598 omitted, sha256 64ddc3dff78c05d9>
</document>

<hypothesis>
Receiving Party shall notify Disclosing Party in case Receiving Party is required by law, regulation or judicial process to disclose any Confidential Information.
</hypothesis>

<readings>
<reading id="A">
label: Entailment
confidence: 88
reason: Section 4 requires the Recipient or its Representatives, when required by law, regulation or legal proceeding to disclose Confidential Information, to promptly notify the Corporation (the disclosing party), matching the hypothesis, though the document does not expressly mention judicial process in identical terms and uses different party labels.
<quote check="exact">such person or entity will (i) promptly notify the Corporation of the existence, terms and circumstances surrounding such a request or requirement</quote>
<quote check="exact">is required by law, regulation, stock exchange or regulatory authority to disclose any Confidential Information</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="B">
label: Entailment
confidence: 95
reason: Section 4 requires the Recipient to promptly notify the Corporation when legally required to disclose Confidential Information, unless the law prohibits such notice.
<quote check="exact">or is required by law, regulation, stock exchange or regulatory authority to disclose any Confidential Information, such person or entity will (i) promptly notify the Corporation of the existence, terms and circumstances surrounding such a request or requirement</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="C">
label: Entailment
confidence: 95
reason: Section 4 requires the Recipient to promptly notify the Corporation when disclosure is legally required or requested in legal proceedings.
<quote check="exact">is required by law, regulation, stock exchange or regulatory authority to disclose any Confidential Information, such person or entity will (i) promptly notify the Corporation of the existence, terms and circumstances surrounding such a request or requirement</quote>
</reading>
</readings>

The readings are evidence about where to look, not votes: a majority can be wrong, and a quote marked "missing" was not found in the document. Read the relevant parts of the document yourself.

Choose exactly one label:
- Entailment: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is true.
- Contradiction: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is false.
- NotMentioned: the document does not address the hypothesis, or says too little to decide.

Evidence is required. For Entailment or Contradiction, give 1 to 3 quotes copied character for character from the document (no paraphrase, no ellipses), each as short as it can be while still carrying the point. They will be checked against the document. For NotMentioned, give an empty list.

Give a confidence from 0 to 100: your probability, in percent, that your label is correct. Give a one-sentence reason.

Answer only with the JSON object the response format asks for: label, confidence, quotes, reason.

content.text: {"label":"Entailment","confidence":95,"quotes":["is required by law, regulation, stock exchange or regulatory authority to disclose any Confidential Information, such person or entity will (i) promptly notify the Corporation of the existence, terms and circumstances surrounding such a request or requirement"],"reason":"Section 4 requires the Recipient to promptly notify the Corporation when legal process or law requires disclosure of Confidential Information, which matches the hypothesis."}
